# LocalMeasurementSheaf

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mathematical structure that assigns local measurement spaces to each node and consistency conditions to overlapping regions, enabling global inference from local data. This provides a formal way to reason about how local measurements combine into global topological properties, crucial for decentralized computation.
